questions: Nothing prices a ward model. Is a per-pulse ward at 10 % fair against a drain ward, when the drain ward in a mirror pays several times that?
The same 123 W as plain attack fights about as well as this stack. Are body guard and health sized too low, or is an empty L1 simply the best first purchase?
